paragraphs: In the morning, carry instruments into the workshop to measure dust and noise and inspect guards and warnings. At midday, enter data into the system, compare limits, and flag hazards in red. In the afternoon, agree on corrective deadlines with team leaders and track progress. Before leaving, organize records and reinspection plans for next week's inspection points.

In short, they identify hazards before incidents occur.
